# 1 Enoch Chapter 18 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** I saw the storehouses of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole of creation and the firm foundations of the earth.

**2** And I saw the cornerstone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear the earth and the firmament of heaven.

**3** And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth — these are the pillars of heaven.

**4** I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting.

**5** I saw the wind upon the earth carrying the clouds; I saw the paths of the angels. I saw at the end of the earth the firmament of heaven above.

**6** And I went on and saw a place that burns day and night, where there are seven mountains of magnificent stones — three toward the east and three toward the south.

**7** And as for those toward the east: one was of colored stone, one of pearl, and one of jacinth; and those toward the south were of red stone.

**8** But the middle one reached to heaven like the throne of God, of alabaster, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire.

**9** And I saw a flaming fire. And beyond these mountains is a region at the end of the great earth, where the heavens were completed.

**10** And I saw a deep abyss, with columns of heavenly fire; and among them I saw columns of fire falling, which were beyond measure in height and depth alike.

**11** And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of heaven above it, and no firmly founded earth beneath it; there was no water upon it, and no birds — but it was a waste and terrible place.

**12** I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains; and when I asked concerning them,

**13** the angel said to me: 'This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.

**14** And the stars which roll in the fire are they who have transgressed the commandment of the Lord at the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

**15** And He was wroth with them, and bound them until the time when their guilt should be consummated — even for ten thousand years.'

**16** And Uriel said to me: 'Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women; and their spirits, assuming many different forms, are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as to gods. They shall stand here until the day of the great judgment, in which they shall be judged until they are made an end of.'

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 18 contains the climax of the first cosmic journey — the prison of the disobedient stars and the Watchers (vv. 10–16). The cosmological section (vv. 1–9) describes the infrastructure of creation: winds, pillars, the firmament, and the seven throne-mountains. V. 16, delivered by Uriel, explicitly identifies the abyss as the future prison of the Watchers who consorted with women — connecting the Watcher narrative of chs. 6–16 with the cosmic geography of the journey.*
